What's the biggest risk you've ever taken? Did it pay off?

A few months ago, I moved 5000 km without a job lined up on the other end and with a sedan-full of my and my girlfriend's stuff. We were both stir crazy and were in the mood for something crazy.

Got solid jobs almost immediately and live in a cool place. It's hard making friends, though. I'm happier than I was though, so I'll call it a win.

Saved up money for 6 years, paid off all debt, then packed up and moved to the middle of nowhere. I had no idea if my boss would let me telecommute (he did), I had no idea how the satellite internet would work (it sucks but is usable). I've learned a lot in the last few years when it comes to working knowledge, firewood, growing food, water, hunting etc. I feel like the previous 30 years of my life were wasted, I didn't really experience life until moving here.
I flew to the other side of the world to live with a girl I'd never met in a land I'd never visited. Long story short, we've been happily married for five years. Yes it paid off!
